test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All ships are eggs.

Some eggs are pencils.

All coins are ships.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some ships are pencils.

(II): Some eggs are coins.6376
solution:
**Statements:**

All ships are eggs.

Some eggs are pencils.

All coins are ships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6a96ab734de0dd67528daca19fe3d1f7a0c72e8d2b933da5361f3be8534708c.png] 

**Conclusion (I): Some ships are pencils**: **Does not follows** (because, We only know that some eggs are pencils.It is not necessary that those eggs are ships.)

**Checking Conclusion (II): Some eggs are coins**: **Follows** (because,All coins are ships and all ships are eggs.So, all coins are eggs.Hence, some eggs can definitely be coins.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
